tracklist.check: Level 5: >=2 independent sources of the same edition must agree on count, order and titles – MET. MusicBrainz (step 3), Discogs 1951581 (step 4) and musik-sammler (step 16) all give 16 tracks in the order A1–B8 with identical durations (total 2979 s). Differences are spelling only: 'Nute Bounce'/'Nutte Bounce', 'Pitbull'/'Pit Bull', 'Hast du Mut'/'Hast Du Mut?', 'Vack You!'. MusicBrainz and Discogs differ in their details, which indicates independent entries.
tracklist.summary: Three sources with differing details agree exactly on 16 tracks, their order and durations, with only spelling variants.

sources.check: Level 5: database plus an independent primary source of the same edition – NOT MET. concerns: Catalogue number is inconsistent: the result says 'ILM 003' (from MusicBrainz), Discogs gives '03', and the J-card print reads 'ILM1' (step 8).

The labelling 'Erstauflage (Limited Edition)' combines the Discogs first pressing with the musik-sammler 'Limited Edition' entry. It is not shown that both, or the MusicBrainz release, describe the same pressing. This does not affect the tracklist.
Title spellings follow Discogs; MusicBrainz differs at A6 ('Nute Bounce'), B3 ('Pitbull') and B6 ('Hast du Mut'), and musik-sammler differs at B8 ('Vack You!').
The A8 featured artists are given as Bass Sultan Hengzt & King Orgasmus One (MusicBrainz), whereas musik-sammler names the aliases 'Baktus & Orgasmus'.
